name: RaceDay CI CD Build and Unit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout Code Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Setup .NET 8 SDK
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v3
      with:
        dotnet-version: 8.0.x

    - name: Restore Dependencies
      run: dotnet restore RaceDayApi.sln

    - name: Build Solution
      run: dotnet build RaceDayApi.sln --no-restore --configuration Release

    - name: Execute Automated xUnit Unit Tests
      run: dotnet test RaceDayApi.Tests/RaceDayApi.Tests.csproj --no-build --verbosity normal
